why_selected: Creator request; the most-discussed tech story of the day, verified on Nvidia's own press releases.
why_short: Nvidia's CEO quit, then came back 11 days later.

disclosure: Disclosure: written by Claude, an Anthropic model. Nvidia supplies chips across the AI industry; no other conflict known. Personal allegations, politics and the stock move are deliberately left out.
research_summary: Huang's resignation and reinstatement were confirmed on Nvidia's own newsroom, which opens from this environment: the 12 Nov release 'NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition' (Huang resigned effective immediately; CFO Colette Kress interim CEO; Harvey Jones first-ever Chair) and the 23 Nov release reinstating him by a unanimous board vote. The board says its independent committee investigation, formed after reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort, will proceed to conclusion, and it has formed a National Security and Export Control Committee and begun a search for a Chief Compliance Officer. Reported stock moves, personal allegations and political statements are not in the script: the stock figure needs an opened primary, and politics and personal matters are excluded.

script:
Nvidia's CEO quit. Eleven days later, he's back.

On November 12, Jensen Huang resigned from the company Nvidia says he spent 33 years building.

His CFO, Colette Kress, stepped in as interim CEO. And Harvey Jones became chair of the board.

Then on November 23, the board voted unanimously to bring him back, effective immediately.

Huang said he can't wait to get back to work.

But it's not over. The board says its investigation, after reports he was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort, will continue.

He's back, with a lot more oversight.

storyboard.motion_graphics: Checklist: new national-security committee ✓ new Chief Compliance Officer search ✓

recording_v9.opening_expression: Straight face on 'quit', then a beat and raised eyebrows on 'he's back'.
recording_v9.framing: Vertical 9:16, chest-up medium close-up, eyes on the upper third; leave headroom for on-screen text; plain background.
recording_v9.pace: Brisk but clear (about 140 words per minute); slow down slightly on the investigation line.
recording_v9.gestures: Hand flick on 'quit'; two fingers tapping on 'eleven days'; open palm on 'he's back'; small lean-in on 'not over'.

music.style: Tense cinematic corporate pulse, minor key, about 90-100 BPM, light percussion; no lyrics
music.track_suggestion: Search your licensed library for 'cinematic tension corporate pulse' (for example YouTube Audio Library, free; or Epidemic Sound / Artlist if you hold a subscription). No specific track is claimed as licensed.
music.licensing: Use only a track your account is licensed to use on Instagram; keep the licence record
music.opening_cue: Start silent on 'quit', hit the first beat on 'Eleven days later'
beat_changes: Near-silence dip on 'But it's not over'
sfx: Drone swell under the investigation line
music.dialogue_music_balance: Dialogue normalised to about -14 LUFS; music bed around -27 dB under speech, up to about -20 dB in gaps
music.ending_cue: Clean resolve on 'more oversight', 1 s tail

distribution.cover_headline: NVIDIA's CEO quit. Then came back.
distribution.thumbnail_concept: NVIDIA press photo of Jensen Huang (NVIDIA media assets) on one side, bold '11 DAYS' on the other, small dates '12 NOV → 23 NOV'
distribution.posting_angle: A clear, factual explainer of the 11-day CEO reversal, sourced to Nvidia's own releases; no gossip, no politics
distribution.engagement_question: Would you have brought him back?

production_handoff.audio: Denoise and de-reverb dialogue, gentle compression, normalise to -14 LUFS with -1.5 dB true peak; tighten pauses over 0.45 s without clipping words
production_handoff.captions: Word-level burned-in captions from captions.txt, 2-5 words per line; highlight emphasis words; keep clear of the bottom UI area
broll_list: NVIDIA newsroom: 12 Nov release 'NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition' (screenshot)
NVIDIA media assets: Jensen Huang press photo; Colette Kress photo if available; GPU/chip product images (editorial use, confirm terms)
Own graphics: timeline 12→23 Nov, quote card, oversight checklist
production_handoff.notes: Do not use unrelated stock footage or invent product demos; credit NVIDIA on screen for screenshots.
